{{Quote|Where do those folks over there come from? And is it a group, or one person?''"<br />"''Why, a group, of course, sir. They are from the fourth world of Markbee's Star, specifically, from&mdash;if I am not mistaken&mdash;Zeffliffl.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]]|<ref name="TCS" />}}
'''Markbee's Star''' was the primary [[Star/Legends|star]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zeffliffl]], the fourth planet of the [[Star system/Legends|system]].<ref name="TCS" />

{{Star-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Markbee's Star was created by [[Vonda N. McIntyre]] for her novel ''[[The Crystal Star]]''.<ref name="TCS" /> She named the star after her friend Mark Bourne, who helped her with some astronomy relating to the novel.<ref name="Name">{{WebCite|url=http://blog.bookviewcafe.com/2009/04/05/my-year-in-la-the-sci-fi-channel-interview-or-vonda-encounters-makeup|text=My Year in LA: The Sci Fi Channel Interview, or, Vonda Encounters Makeup|author=[[Vonda N. McIntyre]]|date=2009-04-05|archivedate=20090410131654}}</ref>
